app.title: CellPilot AI (read-only Streamlit dashboard)
app.summary: The person points the sidebar at a finished analysis run directory and moves through seven pages in pipeline order. They read headline counts and the cluster embedding, check what share of cells passed quality control, choose one cluster to read its ranked marker genes, and look over the model's cell-type predictions with each cluster's consensus label and the evidence-bounded label hypotheses. They then read the benchmark scores against reference labels, and finish by re-verifying the run's hash manifest and reading its declared limitations. What they get is a judgement of whether the saved run is complete and intact, and what its labels and scores can and cannot support.

task.text: Review the saved results of a completed single-cell analysis run, stage by stage, and confirm the artifacts are intact before trusting or reporting them.

data.text: The output folder of one pipeline run: summary JSON files, per-cell and per-cluster CSV tables, saved plot images, benchmark metrics and a hash manifest of inputs and outputs.
data.item: a single cell's QC values, cluster and predicted cell type, summarised per cluster

stage.text: reviewing a finished single-cell analysis run and checking its integrity, before reporting

mechanism.text: A sidebar holds the run-directory path and a page radio that switches the main area between stage pages. Each page reads only that stage's saved files and shows them as metric tiles, plot images and tables, with a notice in place of anything missing. The clusters page filters the marker table to the cluster chosen in a dropdown, and the provenance page rehashes the manifest and reports pass or fail.

field.text: single-cell RNA-seq clustering and reference-based cell-type annotation in genomics

workflow.name: review a completed analysis run stage by stage and confirm it is intact

steps.here: A sidebar text box takes the run directory, prefilled from an environment variable, a --run-dir argument or a latest-run pointer file. A page radio picks the stage to view.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: The overview shows metric tiles for cells and genes after QC, cluster count and variable-gene count, the cluster embedding and marker dot plot side by side, and the raw stage-status record.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The QC page shows the pre-filter distribution plot, the share of cells passing every QC rule, and a describe() summary of each numeric QC column.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: A cluster dropdown narrows the ranked marker table to one cluster, shown under the embedding and dot plot.

The annotation pages show model metadata, the per-cluster consensus table, up to 500 per-cell predictions and an embedding coloured by predicted label. Next to these are the label hypotheses for each cluster, with a warning that they are not validation.
The benchmark page sets predictions against reference classes: tiles for cells, mapped coverage, strict accuracy and macro-F1, a confusion-matrix image and a per-class precision/recall table.
The provenance page rehashes every input and output in the manifest, shows a pass with counts or a fail with the issue list, and then lists the run's declared limitations.

distinctive: Read-only by design: it never reruns analysis, and shows an 'artifact not available' notice instead of filling in a missing value.
Integrity check built in: the run manifest is rehashed against the files on disk, cached per manifest revision, and a failure tells the person not to trust the run.
Model cell-type calls are shown as per-cluster consensus fractions next to per-cell predictions, so weak agreement within a cluster stays visible.
Benchmark scores are strict: predictions outside the label mapping count as errors, and mapped coverage is reported next to accuracy.
Label hypotheses are shown with an explicit warning that they are evidence-bounded, and the run's declared limitations are listed at the end.

parts.title: Run directory and page picker
parts.summary: Lets the person choose which saved run to read and which pipeline stage page to show.

parts.title: Overview
parts.summary: Shows headline counts for the run as metric tiles, the cluster embedding and marker dot plot side by side, and the stage-status record.

parts.title: QC
parts.summary: Shows the QC distributions before filtering, the share of cells passing all rules, and summary statistics for each numeric QC column.

parts.title: Clusters & markers
parts.summary: Shows the cluster embedding and marker dot plot, with a dropdown that narrows the ranked marker table to one cluster.

parts.title: Cell-type annotation and interpretation
parts.summary: Shows the annotation model's metadata, the per-cluster consensus labels, per-cell predictions and a label-coloured embedding, and the evidence-bounded label hypotheses for each cluster.

parts.title: Benchmark
parts.summary: Reports how well predictions match reference classes: coverage, strict accuracy and macro-F1 tiles, a confusion-matrix image and a per-class metrics table.

parts.title: Provenance & limitations
parts.summary: Rehashes the run's recorded inputs and outputs and reports pass or fail with the issues, then shows the manifest and lists the run's declared limitations.
